gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-karma: Baloo Tammudu 2 is rounded and loud, its e opening wide instead of closing its eye. Karma, a text serif with mild letterpress-style shading and terminals held clear of the stem, keeps a long page of paragraphs smooth and untroubled.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-paquito: Rounded, lofty lowercase gives Baloo Tammudu 2 its swagger. It earns its keep big and brief, while Paquito, a classic serif with barely any gap between x-height and caps, backs it up with an easygoing, confident voice.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads dignified and unhurried, a text serif with a gaping c and lofty rounded lowercase. Balsamiq Sans moves in above it with bold, bent-tube lines that never pinch, a moderate-height counterpoint to that stately body.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fauna-one: Balsamiq Sans draws like bent rope, never pinching a curve. It is made for bold, expressive display lines, while Fauna One, a literary serif with shallow ascenders and descenders and a generous e, does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-glegoo: Balsamiq Sans bends its strokes like a steel rod, bold and expressive. Shrink it small and that rod-like energy fades, and Glegoo, a classic serif with big counters and open-mouthed curves, wants the larger share of the page.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding from the first glance, Baumans cuts every stroke at a single thickness, its c flung open like a wrench. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a gaping c and lofty, rounded lowercase, adds the shading and dignity that the heading leaves out.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-fauna-one: Wrench-wide c, no swelling strokes: that is Baumans. And Fauna One, a serif with a high middle band and shallow ascenders, brings the shading and literary warmth the heading lacks, which is the real strength of the pair.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s. And Baumans, drawn like bent tubing with a crescent-wrench c, gives it a commanding, distinctive heading to lean on.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kadwa: Kadwa has a larger-than-usual x-height and curves left open at their ends, editorial in feel. Kadwa carries the reading, while Baumans, with no thick-to-thin shading at all, takes the commanding display role.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pridi: Refined and classic, Pridi sets small letters almost at capital height, with generous space where curves meet the stem. And Baumans, with its contrast-free strokes and wrench-wide c, makes the sharpest single contrast against it.
